scope: Independent 0PN first-bend segment model with nine families of wall and streaming brane tips sharing an exterior curl stress. Measured signed waist-to-middle resultant at the archived early and late instants, and at the full transit.
model: One neutral-site shear cell per pitch of normal depth and 9/12 candidate coverage. Linearized orientationally averaged central binding, two unit-drag tips, fixed wall backbone with unit grip, transported nonaffine brane tip. Hat weights divide contact transfer between neighboring material labels. Derivative of the imposed bend is supported on 0.55 to 1.15. Read from waist 0.5 to middle 1.175. Temperature zero. Inlet nonaffine offsets vanish.
calibration: The unity-grip control rescales the surface and stream families together to match the archived instantaneous tangential coefficient. It does not match the relaxation time or the first finite-time force. Frozen-neighbor brane grip is obtained for each site from the same-plane energy with neighbors fixed and isotropic orientation averaging. The material-clock and coverage assumptions of the different models remain distinct.
